FAQ

Cleaning Questions, Answered

Still curious? Call 403-808-4704

What areas does Promaster Cleaning serve?

We're based in northwest Calgary and serve homes and businesses across Calgary, Alberta and the surrounding towns and cities.

Do you clean both homes and businesses?

Yes. We provide residential cleaning for houses, condos and apartments, plus commercial, office and janitorial cleaning for retail stores, medical clinics, residential buildings and other facilities.

How often can you clean?

Choose weekly, bi-monthly or monthly service, or book a one-time deep clean, move-in or move-out clean, or post-construction clean.

Is your team licensed and insured?

Promaster Cleaning Services is fully licensed, insured and bonded. Every team member is carefully screened and trained.

How do I get a cleaning quote?

Call or text 403-808-4704, email promastercleaningservices@gmail.com, or use the quote form on this page. Estimates are free.

What are your hours?

We're available weekdays from 8 am to 10 pm, and weekends and holidays from 9 am to 6 pm.
